# TiDB reject-fuzz known over-acceptances (baseline). family<TAB>sql.
# Each is a real omni-accept/TiDB-reject; to be minimised into
# compat.tsv and fixed across the forks (PR e), then dropped here.
#
# The space-before-paren over-acceptances (`select count ( * )` and the
# spaced aggregate/scalar forms it shared a cause with) are fixed in
# checkSpacedFuncWord (tidb/parser/temporal.go), held by TestTiDBSpacedFuncWords.
#
# `*` as a comparison operand, which TiDB answers 1064: found 2026-11-12, when
